title: Comparative Study of Anatomical and Learned Features in AI Models for Structural Brain MRI
abstract: arXiv:2609.06807v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work, we comprehensively evaluate three popular feature-extraction paradigms in AI-based neuroimaging modeling: (1) computation of anatomical surfaces and volumes, (2) supervised learning with convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and (3) unsupervised pretraining of vision transformer (ViT) foundation models, followed by supervised finetuning. Our study is based on 18 publicly available datasets containing 3D structural T1-weighted MRI scans from approximately 80,000 participants across seven distinct clinical tasks. We observe that a linear model based on anatomical features matches the diagnostic performance of complex nonlinear features learned by sophisticated AI frameworks, including foundation models trained on thousands of scans. translated_title: 结构性脑部MRI人工智能模型中解剖特征与学习特征的比较研究
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们全面评估了基于AI的神经影像建模中三种流行的特征提取范式：(1) 解剖表面和体积的计算，(2) 使用卷积神经网络(CNN)的监督学习，(3) 视觉Transformer (ViT)基础模型的无监督预训练加监督微调。我们的研究基于18个公开可用的数据集，包含来自约80,000名参与者的3D结构性T1加权MRI扫描，涵盖七项不同的临床任务。我们观察到，基于解剖特征的线性模型在诊断性能上可以与复杂AI框架学习到的复杂非线性特征相媲美，包括在数千次扫描上训练的基础模型。相反，CNN和预训练的ViT所学习的特征能够隐式地捕捉相关的解剖信息，从而绕过了显式特征提取的需要。基于这些见解，我们……
tldr: 该研究基于约8万名参与者的MRI数据发现，基于解剖特征的简单线性模型在脑部疾病诊断性能上可媲美复杂的深度学习基础模型，而深度学习模型本身也能隐式捕捉关键的解剖信息。
en_tdlr: Based on ~80,000 participants' MRI scans, this study shows that a simple linear model on anatomical features matches the diagnostic performance of complex deep learning foundation models, while CNNs and pretrained ViTs implicitly capture relevant anatomical information.
